how_to_apply: Visit the Bank's careers website, https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/, and download the detailed advertisement for the relevant post before applying.
Click "Apply Online" and register for the specific post using a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number.

On successful registration, an activation link will be sent to the registered e-mail ID, and a Registration Number and Password will be sent to the registered mobile number - note these carefully, as they are required to proceed.
Click the activation link sent to your e-mail, which will direct you to the careers portal.

Log in using the Application/Registration Number and password, and fill in all details carefully, clicking "Save/Continue" on every page. Ensure your name and your father's/husband's name are spelt exactly as they appear on your certificates/mark sheets.
Upload your photograph (390 x 520 pixels preferred, maximum 120 KB) and signature (240 x 240 pixels preferred, maximum 60 KB, not in capital letters) in the specified format.

Upload the following enclosures, each not exceeding 250 KB: self-attested copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate (for age proof), self-attested copy of Degree Certificate(s), Experience Certificate(s) and Relieving Letter for previous employment, and last month's salary slip.
Review all details, then click "Confirm/Submit" - a message confirming "Registration is successful" will be displayed on successful submission.
A copy of the system-generated application form will be sent to your registered e-mail; take a printout for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications can be submitted only online through TMB's website; no other mode of submission will be accepted by the Bank. Candidates must register with a correct, valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and keep them active until the recruitment process is complete, as call letters may be sent by e-mail. Any change or alteration found in the name of the candidate or their father's/husband's name (compared to certificates/mark sheets) may disqualify the candidature. e-Applications with incorrect or incomplete particulars, or without the required certificate copies attached, are liable to be rejected. Candidates should adhere strictly to the eligibility conditions given; any information found to be wrong, or any candidate found ineligible at any stage of the process or later, will result in disqualification. The Bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate ineligible candidates, at any point before, during, or after the interview/selection process, without assigning any reason, and the Bank's decision in these matters is final. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The job role and location for all posts are subject to transfer based on the Bank's requirements.

content_sections.heading: TMB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility differs for each post. All ages are reckoned as on 31-07-2026 (except Manager – Generalist, for which no specific reference date is given). For all posts, candidates identified for appointment must have no vigilance case or adverse observation pending against them from the RBI or any Statutory Authority. Only Indian nationals may apply, and the place of posting for every post is anywhere in India, subject to transfer based on requirement.

content_sections.text: Selection for all posts is through a Personal Interview only - there is no written examination. Any change or alteration found in the name of the candidate or their father's/husband's name (compared to certificates/mark sheets) may disqualify the candidature. e-Applications with incorrect or incomplete particulars, or without the required certificate copies attached, are liable to be rejected. Candidates should adhere strictly to the eligibility conditions given; any information found to be wrong, or any candidate found ineligible at any stage of the process or later, will result in disqualification. The Bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate ineligible candidates, at any point before, during, or after the interview/selection process, without assigning any reason, and the Bank's decision in these matters is final. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The job role and location for all posts are subject to transfer based on the Bank's requirements.

faq.question: Q1. What is TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. (TMB) for five posts - Agricultural Officer, Specialist Officer (Civil Engineer), Specialist Officer (Law – Manager and Assistant Manager grades), Manager (Generalist), and Security Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online e-application is 06-09-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post: a Degree in Agriculture (minimum 50% marks) for Agricultural Officer, B.E./B.Tech for Specialist Officer (Civil Engineer), BL/ML for Specialist Officer (Law), and any Graduate/Post Graduate for Manager (Generalist) and Security Officer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post: 30 years for Agricultural Officer and Specialist Officer (Civil Engineer), 40 years for Specialist Officer – Law (Manager grade), 35 years for Specialist Officer – Law (Assistant Manager grade) and Manager (Generalist), and 50 years for Security Officer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee (Nil) for any of the posts in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online at https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/ between 24-08-2026 and 06-09-2026, after registering with a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Personal Interview only (Direct or Video Conferencing); there is no written examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for TMB posts?
faq.answer: Remuneration is as applicable to the relevant cadre (Assistant Manager or Manager) for most posts, while the Security Officer post carries a consolidated pay of ₹50,000 per month plus allowances applicable to the Senior Manager cadre.

faq.question: Q9. Where will TMB Recruitment 2026 selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The place of posting for all posts is anywhere in India, and the job role and location are subject to transfer based on the Bank's requirements.
